model: 193 spectral-profile features + ExtraTrees(500, balanced), user-confirmed/auto crop
cv: leave-one-contaminant-out; each water image treated as an independent sample (UNVERIFIED assumption)
note: Contaminants covered: bavistin, carbendazim, DAP, dimethoate, imidacloprid, neem-coated urea vs water. If the 22 water images are repeat captures of one sample, accuracy drops to ~69% (never sees safe water). Dataset labels, not lab measurements.
